# lumos_workflow (Resource)

Workflow Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lumos_workflow" "my_workflow" {
  app_id      = "...my_app_id..."
  description = "...my_description..."
  name        = "...my_name..."
  steps = [
    {
      inputs = {
        # ...
      }
      step = "...my_step..."
    }
  ]
  type = "approval-chain"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for this Workflow.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The ordered steps of the workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))
- `type` (String) The kind of workflow. must be one of ["approval", "approval-chain", "entitlement-provisioning", "entitlement-deprovisioning", "account-provisioning", "account-deprovisioning"]

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) UUID of the app this Workflow belongs to. May be null for a shared, not-yet-associated Workflow. Immutable on update: a PUT whose app_id differs from the stored Workflow's app is rejected with a 400 (workflow.app_reassignment_not_allowed).
- `description` (String) A description of this Workflow.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A UUID identifying this Workflow.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Optional:

- `inputs` (Attributes) The configured inputs for this step. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--inputs))
- `step` (String) Identifier (catalogue slug) for the step to execute. Not Null

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Server-derived human-readable name for this step. Read-only.

<a id="nestedatt--steps--inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.inputs`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = lumos_workflow.my_lumos_workflow
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lumos_workflow.my_lumos_workflow "..."
```
